title: Make exceptional explanations repeatable and adaptable

verificationRecords.notes: Complete app, Node, test, Svelte and domain type checks passed for saved-link restoration and explicit programme approval.
Exact user URL: Chromium and Firefox, 1100 and 390 widths, load/reload, eight original beats, native endpoint, saved reading position and TOC reversal. Shared review server also returns HTTP200.
Exact saved-link first scroll and six versioned transitions; focus-caused compositor builds drop to zero. One first-entry preparation hitch remains; no general frame-rate guarantee.
Final preservation cohort used saved version, annotation fades, both readers, reader gives, and focused follow-up selection: ten Chromium/Firefox cases passed after the compositor repair.

Initial run found a missing roadmap promotion-ledger link; repaired and promotion gate passed on rerun. Broad suite then deliberately terminated to remove CPU load during user-reported motion diagnosis; no clean full-suite claim.

verificationRecords.command: npm run visual:anchored-algebra -- --project=firefox --grep "saved version|annotation fades|both readers|reader gives|focused follow-up"
verificationRecords.notes: Exact final post-repair command; ten cases passed across Chromium and Firefox.

Diagnostic completed six Firefox startup traces; reproduced a 55px equation jump and fallback-to-measured card growth. This is evidence of a remaining defect, not a stability pass. No production change in this follow-up.

Navigation-time assertions pass for saved v1, both openings, and fractional reader at desktop and phone widths in Chromium and Firefox. Native ink is stable after first paint. Failure/delay and standard-reader canaries also pass; see saved-reading-and-motion review for commands, limitations, unit and type evidence.

Final run: 7 passed, one intentional Chromium-only ownership-canary skip in Firefox. Three readers preserve paint through reversal, held frames, motion revision, resize, fonts and disposal. Stale pure-plan color reuse repaired at shared cache boundary.

verificationRecords.command: npm run visual:anchored-algebra -- --project=firefox --grep "startup keeps|saved version-1|both readers release|annotation fades|transition diagnostic"
verificationRecords.notes: 9 passed, one intentional Firefox-only diagnostic skip in Chromium. Startup, saved v1, focus and fades preserved. Cold saved-link transition still measured 51ms; no universal smoothness claim.

11 preservation tests passed; 28 focused runtime/reading/startup tests, app/Node/test type checks and 75 project vision/orientation tests also passed. See source-linked motion review for commands and limits.

progress.summary: Automatic preparation amendment complete and verified. Broader programme remains open; real-revision editorial judgment is next. Cold preparation is still measurable; avoid repeating accepted typography/startup work or claiming live fast generation.
